description: This file defines the OrderSummary class, used as an input object for services like order total and tax calculations within the sales manager system.

classes.name: OrderSummary
classes.description: A data transfer object representing a summary of an order, including shipping details and list of products.

methods.name: setProducts
methods.description: Sets the list of shopping cart items included in the order summary.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves the list of shopping cart items included in the order summary.

methods.name: setShippingSummary
methods.description: Sets the shipping summary details for the order.

methods.name: getShippingSummary
methods.description: Retrieves the shipping summary details for the order.
